boundary: Representation-only optimization: identical field operations, complete solution sets, relation streams and recovered scalar. No change to the generic-group floor or asymptotic exponent.
target: Remove pivot-row and memo-result copying. Require exact solver outputs and existing arithmetic counters. Report paired cold process time, with no speedup claim unless a paired 95% confidence interval excludes one.
wdsat_exception: This is the prime-cubic-field Gaudry symmetrized-S4 solver, not binary ANF WDSat. Replay the same 60 residuals per stage case, plus fresh holdouts, against the unmodified solver and independent MITM oracle.
reason_primary_null: Existing solver counters and rho calibration are retained; cold instance/factor-base construction and runtime bookkeeping are not fully calibrated in common operations. Process timings cover those phases, but cannot establish a total-operation speedup.
